636c7922:  ;
 ;This routine prints patient/division/date/physician and service
 ;related data from the VAS data global ^UTILITY("VAS",$J).
 ;This data was compiled by other routines according to the
 ;option selected.
c75583a6: ;This line handles printing based on the option selected.
37279c90: ;Go to ^DGJOPRT3 if there are more nodes to process.
6df5e732: ;Set DGJTDV1 for use in DIV label.
d371b161: ;Print division data for the selected option.
e7f8cbc4: ;Print data by date for the selected option.
f1034ebb: ;If not already printed, print the header.

3b5c42c9:  ;For the selected option, loop through services.
 ;Print header data, reset flag, loop through specialties for each service.
 ;Call SER1 to print patient data by specialty.
b8218210: ;Loop through patients by admission date.
b98ff8be: ;Print details for each admission date.
a7655fee: ;Loop through services, specialties, and patients.
d6617db5: ;Loop through patients for each service and specialty.
11a131f6: ;Exit patient loop for service and specialty.
33a4e404: ;Print details for each patient, service, and specialty.
7a193eb9: ;Exit patient detail loop for service and specialty.
7f8b1ef5: ;Get physician name if not printing by physician.
19d96c17: ;If physician output, print additional physician details
8de076eb: ;If output is not coming to the terminal (IOST doesn't contain 'C-'), go to RET1.
a14f80e5: ;If output is not coming to the terminal, quit.
00037f32: ;Loop through the blank lines until 3 lines before the end of the page (IOSL).
acc1a619: ;Prompt user to continue or quit. Set DGU flag if user quits.
69ee2bb5: ;If output is for PAT or DAT and the current line is near the bottom of the page, get user input to continue and print a new header.
247bc31b: ;If the current line is near the bottom of the page and output is to the terminal, get user input to continue and print a new header.
